study: Q1 evolutionary assurance versus investment under visitor replenishment
research_question: Does the original four-setting A-evolvability x visitor-replenishment investment interaction persist across independently redrawn founding diploid genomes?
source_note: Exactly the original Model3 reproduction, population, history and registered four mating settings; no biological retuning, different founder RNG seeds. Study is a NEW cohort, not a continuation of prior Q1 evidence.
outcome: mean inherited investment I at period 1000 among occupied populations; never set extinct I=0
primary_estimand: For each setting and founder f and visitor seed h, D(f,h) = (I_evolving,far - I_evolving,near) - (I_fixed,far - I_fixed,near). Report original Model3 raw I units; all four cells same founder, visitor seed and demographic repeat.
inference_units: 8 independent founder draws x 8 independent exogenous visitor histories in a crossed design, not 64 independent island histories; outcomes in each 4-treatment cell share stochastic parent draws as matched common random numbers
eligibility: Require every one of 1088 original-design cases and SHA-verified original readout, and all 32 exact 0-mutation fixed/evolving matched traces. If any terminal population extinct in the four matched main cells, report occupancy and declare endpoint-D classification inconclusive (do not select surviving groups silently).

bootstrap.description: Separately resample the 8 founding-genome IDs and the 8 visitor-history IDs with replacement. Use the full 8x8 crossed matrix (two-way crossed cluster bootstrap); do NOT resample 64 founder-visitor cells as independent islands.
bootstrap.setting_multiplicity: all four settings required (conjunctive gate); no individual nominal p-value as a universal law

registered_support_rule: Confirmed fresh-founder model-conditional persistence of Q1 sign only if 1088-case provenance and null control all pass, all 1024 main paths occupied, and EVERY one of the four settings has D mean >0, 2-way crossed founder/visitor bootstrap lower 95% >0, and at least six of eight founder-specific D means >0.
registered_failure_rule: If the exact cohort and null pass but ANY of four settings has D mean <=0, report not-general-across-four for this fresh-founder grid. If any bootstrap interval contains zero, fewer than 6/8 founders positive, missing data or extinction occurs, classify inconclusive; do not extend or tune the cohort based on outcomes.
report_all: For every mating setting: 8x8 original four-cell endpoint means, all arm means and relative evolvable minus fixed within each arm, founder-specific means/signs, visitor-specific means/signs, occupancy, 2-way bootstrap, and all null-control pairs. Preserve failures and unhelpful results.
claim_limits: Not external validation by another biological model; no real-island calibration or selfing-frequency measurement
Eight founder backgrounds and eight visitor histories are two crossed sources of variation; not 64 independent islands
Shared ecological equations and reproductive settings cannot validate that those equations are biologically correct
A-mode manipulation changes heritable capacity and all downstream feedback, not a unique direct mediation fraction
Both visitor regimes remain synthetic pollen-limited arms; no saturated mainland comparator
The original Q1 registered 4/4 finding remains unchanged even if this separate new cohort fails
No manuscript claim promotion before every prospectively frozen case, source manifest and readout are admitted
